official_measurement_examples.name: Planning before licence
official_measurement_examples.fact: GOV.UK states a caravan site normally needs planning permission before an application for the site licence is made.

official_measurement_examples.name: Licence duration relationship
official_measurement_examples.fact: GOV.UK states the caravan site licence lasts as long as the planning permission for the site, subject to the licensing framework.

official_measurement_examples.name: Licence conditions
official_measurement_examples.fact: Local authorities may attach site-licence conditions covering layout, caravan types and facilities; those conditions are separate from planning conditions.

official_measurement_examples.name: Fit and proper person regime
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2020 regulations prohibit operation of relevant protected sites unless the local authority is satisfied that the owner or appointed manager meets the fit-and-proper requirement, subject to specified exceptions.

official_measurement_examples.name: Register application precondition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government guidance says a site owner may apply for fit-and-proper registration only where they hold or have applied for a site licence for the relevant site.

official_measurement_examples.name: Register decision options
official_measurement_examples.fact: The local authority can place a person on the fit-and-proper register with or without conditions or reject the application under the regulations.

official_measurement_examples.name: Model standards role
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government enforcement guidance says local authorities must have regard to Model Standards when setting relevant residential site-licence conditions; the standards are not themselves a planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Site rules distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2014 Site Rules Regulations govern procedures for site rules under the Mobile Homes Act framework; site rules are distinct from planning permission and site-licence conditions.
